description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Create a Dockerfile to containerize the ContosoUniversity ASP.NET MVC 5 application targeting .NET Framework 4.8 using a Windows-based container image.
tasks.requirements: Create a multi-stage Dockerfile for ContosoUniversity located at ContosoUniversity/ContosoUniversity.csproj. The application targets .NET Framework 4.8 and must use a Windows-based base image (mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/framework/aspnet:4.8-windowsservercore-ltsc2022). The build stage should use mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/framework/sdk:4.8 to compile and publish the application using MSBuild. The final image should copy the published output into the IIS-hosted ASP.NET base image. Include a .dockerignore file to exclude unnecessary files from the build context.
tasks.summary: Created ContosoUniversity/Dockerfile (multi-stage: sdk:4.8 build stage + aspnet:4.8-windowsservercore-ltsc2022 final stage) and ContosoUniversity/.dockerignore.
